## #cptTabs
DATA
layered
## .panel.active
Applications
Use the interpreted CPT profile for first engineering calculations. Stage 6 reuses the active CPT, current layer model, current water table, and accepted Stage 5 tuning.
REFRESH
STAGE 7 REPORT
Bearing
Piles
Settlement
Dewatering
Beam/slab
Retaining walls
Seep/Slope
Active CPT: layered · WT = 1.70 m below surface · parameter source = EC7 / NEN Table 3 · Stage 5 tuned m = used where accepted
Settlement
SLS settlement at the footing / slab centreline from CPT-derived E_oed with explicit stress integration below Df.
INPUTS
The reported settlement is the vertical settlement beneath the centre of the loaded area. For a strip footing this is the centreline in section; for a rectangular, square, circular footing or slab it is the middle of the footprint.
Footing type
Strip
Rectangular / slab
Square
Circular
Width B (m)
Length L (m)
Founding depth Df (m)
Stress spread
Boussinesq / Newmark
2:1 method
Truncation rule
Delta sigma < 10% sigma'v0
Delta sigma < 20% q_net
Use CPT bottom
Sub-layer dz (m)
Target allowable settlement (mm)
Show settlement time curve
LOAD ASSUMPTIONS AND EUROCODE COMBINATION
Stress increase Delta sigma_v vs depth
Cumulative settlement vs depth

FORMULA USED
Delta eps = Delta sigma_v / E_oed(sigma_mean)
Delta S = Sum(Delta eps * Delta z)
Evaluation point = centre of loaded area
Stress method = Boussinesq / Newmark centreline
Soil route = Characteristic E_oed,ref and m
Load route = SLS quasi-permanent
Truncation = CPT bottom reached
